target_intent: Plan REL-DOC-007 for active target 0.11.0-w2: move search index maintenance heavy work out of Electron main process into worker or child isolation while preserving responsive Settings, tray, window, and MCP read/search behavior.
user_priorities: Isolate full keyword rebuild, SQLite FTS writes, tokenizer enrichment, VACUUM/compact, semantic embedding, and HNSW build/compact outside the main process.
Prove responsiveness with status/cancel IPC latency and main-process heartbeat thresholds, not just quick enqueue return.
Protect committed searchable state via worker-owned SQLite write connection and generation/revision staging swap.
Bound large-file tokenizer cost and prevent query-time synchronous HNSW rebuild.
Include packaged worker native-load smoke and opt-in large-corpus benchmark evidence.
ambiguities: Exact isolation boundary may be worker_threads, child process, or an equivalent runtime.
Generation swap schema and migration shape must be finalized during implementation.
Large-corpus benchmark source should remain opt-in and temp-index based.
Backup-skip UX wording and redacted manifest format need implementation design.
non_coding_signals: Stability=evolving and Status=planned; feasible for planning and implementation, not ready for stable promotion.
MCP indexing controls must remain absent; controls stay Settings IPC/UI only.
Verification must include test, benchmark, package smoke, and review evidence.
